summary: Unify goal-directed authoring across course material, prior/emergent evidence, intended coursework, versioned profiles, practice regeneration and attributed coursework outcomes without local submissions.
rationale: D-013 explicitly extends style-only profiles to targeted course evidence and future-task intent. Distinct prior and emergent evidence, proposed rubrics and immutable revisions preserve attribution. Counterfactual reasoning is within practice/mock exams; instructor outcomes no longer require fabricated submissions. Planner owns obligation changes and no new provider or schedule authority is added.
authorization: User requests in this Codex task on 2026-09-20: unify authoring mechanisms; derive profiles from actual coursework and material without grades; integrate counterfactual reasoning; move actual TA feedback/grades to Coursework before uploading learner work. Follow-up explicitly requests future coursework intent, prior/emergent evidence, UI/REST/MCP exposure, versioned profile reruns, practice regeneration and prepared-agent skills.
validation: 156 backend tests passed, including REST/MCP history/rerun/outcome integration; shared client 9 tests passed; standard, Makitra and starter builds passed; adaptation compatibility checks passed; disposable authoring browser journey passed (future goal, prior/emergent evidence, profile versions/rerun, practice regeneration, grade without submission, narrow screen); rich-lab browser and experience parity/recovery journeys passed. Ruff and uncommitted architecture structural checks passed. The synthetic six-format frontend fixture was updated to span both practice and transfer pools under the authorized selection change. Requested live outcome corrections were verified through the authenticated API, original versions retained and no local submissions created. Committed-diff architecture validation passed against base a8d5c8399946347b6a6bfefe209671730ee6545b. The final standard-frontend build and authoring browser journey passed again after coursework editing and historical source-selection refinements. The installed Learning Gym skill is a symlink to the repository skill and passes quick_validate.py. Checks do not establish human approval or psychometric validity.
rollback: Retain the pre-activation local backup, all immutable profile revisions, generated sets, learner attempts and original artifact versions. Revert code/UI together if needed. Use historical confirmed profile versions for generation, or create new attributed revisions rather than rewriting evidence. Live corrections were performed only through application APIs and are not included as learner data in this commit. Existing outcome records remain readable in shared storage; reverting an interface does not erase them.
